run_cifar10_training: run the cifar10.py module to train a CNN model on CIFAR-10 using TensorFlow ParameterServerStrategy
build_cifar10_model: build a sequential CNN model with Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, and Dense layers for CIFAR-10 classification
create_dataset_pipeline: create a tf.data dataset pipeline that shards, batches, and prefetches CIFAR-10 training data for distributed training
configure_parameter_server: configure a TensorFlow ParameterServerStrategy with TFConfigClusterResolver for distributed training across k8s workers and parameter servers
compile_and_fit_model: compile and fit the CIFAR-10 CNN model with Adam optimizer, SparseCategoricalCrossentropy loss, and accuracy metrics
